ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 35% high-intensity pixels (white distal regions) and 65% low-intensity pixels (dark central and proximal regions).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the distal portions of both the left and right lobes. These are interspersed with small, low-intensity circular mottling spots (approximately 10-15 per lobe). The central region surrounding the median notch is solid low-intensity black/dark grey.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped depression; approximate interior angle of 85 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high frequency and high amplitude variations; jagged, saw-toothed peaks occurring every 10-20 pixels along the boundary, particularly prominent on the inner trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to upturned, convex distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast clusters visible on the left lobe white patch; localized rings and solid dark focal points consistent with previous barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned low-intensity linear streaks visible on the white field of the right lobe, oriented diagonally toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular 'notching' or missing tissue segments along the trailing edge, creating a heavily fragmented profile compared to a smooth geometric curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'splatter' pattern of dark micro-spots concentrated on the lower-left quadrant of the white distal field on the left lobe.
